title: Step through the feed
instruction: Three bits of pseudocode that decide your feed. Step through them line by line and watch the numbers: one mistake in a sum changes the whole feed.

code: for each video in the queue:
next topic = topic with the highest score

steps.input: a Minecraft video, watched to the end

steps.why: Dogs still have the most: 35 is more than 30.

steps.input: a dog video, a tap on “Not interested”
steps.why: “Not interested” takes away 15: 35 − 15 = 20. One tap wipes out almost half the score.
Minecraft has 30, football 22, dogs only 20. One tap and one full watch turned the order around.

code: for each video in the queue:
next topic = random topic you haven’t had for a long time
next topic = topic with the highest score

steps.q: Will the next video be an exploring one?
steps.why: 4 is not divisible by 5, so line 4 doesn’t apply and it goes to line 7: the winning topic.

steps.q: How many of the first 20 videos are exploring ones?
steps.why: The numbers divisible by 5 are 5, 10, 15 and 20. Four videos out of twenty, so 20 % of the feed, are exploring.

steps.input: you watch an exploring cooking video to the end
steps.q: Why is line 5 important for the feed?
options: Without it, the scores of the other topics would never change
steps.why: The network only learns from the videos it has shown you. Without exploring, no new data about other topics appears and the bubble closes.

code: for each video in the queue:
if fewer than 3 videos are left in the queue:
fill the queue with 10 new videos

steps.input: 2 videos are left in the queue
options: The queue is refilled and the loop carries on
The app asks whether you want to carry on
steps.why: Line 4 adds new videos before the queue runs out. The queue is never empty.

steps.input: you have been watching for 2 hours already
options: Never, until you close the app
steps.why: There is no stopping condition in the code. The end is only your decision.

steps.input: you want to add the line “if time > 30 minutes: end the loop”
steps.q: Where do you put it so that it works best?
options: At the start of the loop body, before line 2
At the very beginning, before line 1
steps.why: The condition must be inside the loop so that it is checked before every video. After the loop it would never run, because the loop never ends. Before the loop it would only be checked once.

debrief: A feed is a few lines: scores, a loop and picking the maximum. Small signals, like one “Not interested”, can turn the order around. The exploring line stops the bubble from closing, and the missing stopping condition turns scrolling into a loop without end.
